states.message: Welcome to Renewals and closures! Please select a topic you would like to learn about.
A loan can be renewed by paying the outstanding interest; the principal and tenure reset. Renewal isn't automatic — the customer must request it before the due date.
Customers can pay part of the principal to reduce their outstanding balance and interest, without fully closing the loan or releasing all the pledged gold.
On full payment of principal + interest, verify the customer's ID matches the pledge receipt, then release all pledged gold and mark the loan closed in the system.
On renewal, interest is recalculated from the renewal date at the then-current rate — always confirm the customer knows the new applicable rate before they agree.
